name: pigfarmmix-helper
description: 养猪场mix图鉴助手 — TypeScript 重构版

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:copy && npm run build:web && npm run build:sw
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.sw.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.functions.json && tsc -p workers/push-cron/tsconfig.json
scripts.deploy:db: wrangler d1 execute pigfarmmix --file=functions/db/schema.sql --remote && wrangler d1 execute pigfarmmix --file=functions/db/seed.sql --remote
scripts.dev: npm run build && npx wrangler pages dev dist
scripts.build:copy: mkdir -p dist && cp -R static/css static/data static/img dist/ && cp static/index.html static/manifest.webmanifest static/icon-192.png static/icon-512.png static/icon-maskable.png dist/
